prompt:
Use case: game texture (seamless tile)
Asset type: the cloud layer that drifts over unexplored land on the campaign map of a painted medieval fantasy strategy game (Crownroad: Siege of Ash). The map is the attached hand-painted landscape, seen from high above; this texture is drawn over it with additive-style blending, so black means clear sky and brightness means cloud.
Subject: a thin, airy layer of soft fluffy fair-weather clouds seen from directly above: many small and medium cloudlets of varied size, evenly scattered over the whole square, each with a soft rounded fluffy top, delicate wispy translucent edges and gentle shading (sunlit from the upper left, faint cool blue-grey on the lower right). Between the cloudlets are narrow dark gaps and thin veils of mist. Light and delicate, not a heavy mass.
Style: hand-painted to match the attached map's painterly brushwork, soft and luminous, pure white highlights and pale blue-grey shadows.
Composition: a seamless tileable texture; the cloud cover is even across the whole canvas (about 60% cloud, 40% gap), with no large empty area, no single big cloud and no focal point. Clouds must continue across all four edges so the tile repeats without a seam.
Background: pure solid black (#000000) in the gaps, no texture, no vignette.
Constraints: no land, no ground, no sea, no shadows on any ground, no text, no watermark, no border, no colour other than white, grey and pale blue.
